tha-ap501:1.1: Naḷakuṭikadāyaka.] Himavantass' avidūre Bhāriko nāma pabbato / sayambhū Nārado nāma rukkhamūle vasī tadā. // //
tha-ap501:2.1: Naḷāgāraṃ karitvāna tiṇena chādayiṃ ahaṃ / caṅkamaṃ sodhayitvāna sayambhussa adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap501:3.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agañch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap501:4.1: Tattha me sukataṃ vyamhaṃ naḷakuṭikāya nimmitaṃ / saṭṭhiyojanam ubbiddhaṃ tiṃsayojanavitthataṃ. // //
tha-ap501:5.1: Catuddasesu kappesu devaloke ramiṃ ahaṃ / ekasattatikkhattuñ ca devarajjam akārayiṃ. // //
tha-ap501:6.1: Catuttiṃsakkhattuñ c' eva cakkavatti ahos' ahaṃ / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
tha-ap501:7.1: Dhammapāsādam āruyha sabbāgāravarūpamaṃ / yadicchakāhaṃ vihareyy' Sakyaputtassa sāsane. // //
tha-ap501:8.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi naḷakuṭikāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap501:12.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Naḷakuṭikadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
